name: palette-provider
description: 🎨 Extract intelligent color palettes from images using hybrid median-cut + k-means clustering in OKLAB perceptual space. Auto-classified into dominant, supporting, and accent tiers. React · Vite · Canvas. Live demo.

paragraphs: Extract intelligent color palettes from any image

src="./public/palette-provider.png" width="100%" alt="Palette Provider title art: the wordmark beside a photograph overlaid with the samples feeding its largest color family, a palette panel in family order, and a hue-density ridge below with a peak for every family fanning into its shades."

Palette Provider finds the color families in an image as density peaks in the OKLAB perceptually uniform color space, so a small but distinct color (down to about 1% of the image) is not lost inside a large one. The app shows the palette next to the analysis behind it: how much of the image each family covers, where each family sits in color space, and which pixels fed it.
features: Color Families — Every perceptually distinct color in the image becomes a family with a faithful color and its true share, whether it covers 60% of the image or 2%.
Detail Levels — Essential (one shade per family), Balanced (up to two), or Rich (up to three). Detail adds depth within families; it never adds or removes families.

Color Limit — Show every color, or at most 8, 5, or 3 swatches. When the palette is over the limit, the closest families merge until their shades fit, so Detail decides how the swatches are spent: distinct colors…

Palette Strip — Every color in one strip, ordered by Prevalence (largest shades first) or Family (each family's shades together, families around the hue wheel). Tap a color to copy it and select its family.
Breakdown — Each family as a bar as long as its share of the image, split into its shades, with every shade's value and share.

whatItDoes.text: Extract intelligent color palettes from any image
